subject: C01
host: Mac17,3 / Apple M5 / macOS 27.0.1 (26A434); CommandLineTools ld PROJECT:ld-27037.1
trigger: tauri build sets MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET from bundle.macOS.minimumSystemVersion (13.0). Proc-macro dylibs linked under that target fail dyld validation ('mis-aligned LINKEDIT string pool'), so release builds fail with E0463 can't find crate for tauri_macros/phf_macros/serde_derive.
method: cargo build --release -p serde_derive in an isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR, then ctypes.CDLL(<libserde_derive.dylib>) on the host
also: profile.release strip=debuginfo produced the same dyld failure for proc-macro dylibs even without a deployment target; strip was removed.
alternative_rejected: Lowering minimumSystemVersion to 11.0 would avoid the linker path but declare untested OS support; the qualification contract requires a documented version correction instead.
lockfile: Cargo.lock unchanged; the existing resolution compiles under 1.99.0 with --locked.
review: Bound to the C01 independent review; dependency fingerprint includes the toolchain identity.
